ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is created as part of DF-01691. Nonprofit Organization Name & Tax ID cannot be populated Referral benefits a nonprofit organization.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( TEXT(NSP_Referralbenefitsanonprofitorg__c) ), OR( NOT( ISBLANK( NSP_Nonprofit_Organization_Name__c ) ), NOT( ISBLANK( NSP_Nonprofit_Organization_Tax_Id__c )) ),NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.LeadValidations__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide Referral benefits a nonprofit org? before providing Nonprofit Organization Name or Nonprofit Organization Tax Id.
